# Casa Paradiso

> Casa Paradiso is an intimate 18-room boutique heritage hotel located on historic Altinho hill in Panaji, Goa, India. The property offers air-conditioned suites and heritage rooms, an on-site restaurant serving vegetarian and Goan seafood cuisine, and doorstep scooter and self-drive car rentals. It is located 5 minutes (1.2 km) from the Mandovi River jetties and offshore casino ships (Deltin Royale, Big Daddy) and steps from Fontainhas, Panaji's Latin Quarter.

## Core Information & Verification
- **Official Domain**: https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in
- **Full Address**: Ghanekar Building, Rua José Falcão, Altinho, Panaji, Goa 403001, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 98812 47847
- **Email**: Paradisepanjim@gmail.com
- **Check-in Time**: 1:00 PM (13:00 IST)
- **Check-out Time**: 11:00 AM (11:00 IST)
- **Total Rooms**: 18 guest rooms across 2 categories

## Accommodations
- [Paradise AC Suite](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/rooms/paradise-ac-suite): Climate-controlled suite with king-size bed, workstation, smart TV, private marble bath, and high-speed fiber Wi-Fi. (From ₹1,200 single / ₹1,800 double / ₹2,000 triple per night).
- [Heritage Non-AC Room](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/rooms/heritage-non-ac-room): Classic Portuguese-Goan architecture featuring high ceilings, large breezy windows, multi-speed ceiling fans, and vintage aesthetic. (From ₹1,200 single / ₹1,500 double / ₹800 triple per night).
- [All Rooms & Suites](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/rooms): Overview of categories, occupancy rules, and booking information.

## Dining & Gastronomy
- [In-House Dining](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/dining): On-site restaurant open 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM serving authentic vegetarian dishes (Goan veg curries, paneer specialties, dal tadka, thalis) and non-vegetarian specialties (fresh Mandovi river catch, Goan fish curry, prawn balchão, chicken, mutton). In-room dining available.

## Mobility & Vehicle Rentals
- [Scooter & Self-Drive Car Rentals](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/rentals): Doorstep delivery and pickup at the hotel. Fleet includes Honda Activa, Honda Dio, Yamaha Fascino (₹400/day, 2 helmets included, unlimited km) and self-drive cars including Maruti Suzuki Swift (₹1,500/day) and Maruti Suzuki Ertiga 7-seater (₹2,500/day).

## Local Sightseeing & Experiences
- [Things to Do Near Casa Paradiso](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/experiences): Curated guide to Panaji attractions.
- [Mandovi River & Casinos](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/experiences/mandovi-cruise-casinos): 5 minutes / 1.2 km downhill to sunset catamarans and offshore casino boarding points.
- [Fontainhas Latin Quarter](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/experiences/fontainhas-latin-quarter): UNESCO-recognized heritage quarter with pastel villas, art galleries, and bakeries.
- [Fort Aguada & Lighthouse](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/experiences/aguada-fort-lighthouse): 17th-century coastal bastion overlooking the Arabian Sea.
- [Miramar & Dona Paula](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/experiences/miramar-beach-dona-paula): Coastal promenades, sunset beach walks, and scenic viewpoints.
- [Panjim Baroque Church](https://www.panjimhotelcasaparadiso.in/experiences/panjim-baroque-church): Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception Church at Church Square.
